question: Should Crabbox own, release, and support the Zed registry extension from this repository?
rationale: The implementation preserves architectural boundaries, but accepting a new editor-specific package and external registry lifecycle is a product and maintenance commitment that the contributor cannot establish through code alone.

options.title: Sponsor In Repository
options.body: Accept `integrations/zed` as an official Crabbox surface after live Zed proof demonstrates installation, discovery, and a real CLI-backed operation.

options.title: Keep Extension External
options.body: Have the extension maintained in a separate repository and link it from Crabbox documentation without making it part of Crabbox releases and CI.

recommendation.title: Sponsor In Repository
recommendation.body: Accept `integrations/zed` as an official Crabbox surface after live Zed proof demonstrates installation, discovery, and a real CLI-backed operation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a project-level ownership and distribution choice rather than a narrow implementation defect.
